dataset.name: Multicenter pelvic HGSC cohort (GSE102073)
dataset.description: Independent multicenter high-grade serous pelvic-carcinoma cohort with treatment-naive primary-tumor bulk RNA-seq and individual progression-free-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study selected 96 previously untreated high-grade serous carcinomas to compare tumors with and without serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma. The RNA-seq SubSeries contains 85 unique primary-tumor profiles. Pathology review assigns ovarian, fallopian-tube and primary-peritoneal sites within this shared pelvic HGSC disease spectrum; TRACE Explorer maps the cohort to OV consistently with the existing OV-AU release and does not present it as an ovary-only cohort.

metadata.library_method: Ribo-Zero-depleted stranded total RNA sequencing; STAR 2.3.1z alignment to NCBI build 37 and featureCounts 1.4.3 against GENCODE v18
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO provides exact PFS in months and recurrence status for every RNA-profiled tumor but does not define the clinical day-zero or decompose recurrence, progression and death. The endpoint is therefore exposed as source-defined PFS rather than harmonized TCGA-CDR PFI.
metadata.disease_mapping_note: All 85 profiles are labelled primary ovarian tumor tissue and high-grade serous pelvic carcinoma by GEO. Diagnostic review includes ovarian, fallopian-tube and primary-peritoneal origins, which remain visible in the audit metadata. This release supports HGSC transportability under OV but not ovary-site-specific inference.
metadata.expression_curation_note: Each endpoint-complete GEO sample links to exactly one public featureCounts file. TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 57,445 GENCODE v18 gene rows, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps the versioned Ensembl identifiers with the exact pinned GENCODE v18 annotation and excludes symbols represented by more than one Ensembl gene.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Direct redistribution of the source archive remains disabled because GEO access does not resolve every submitter intellectual-property claim.

include: primary tumor tissue from high grade serous ovarian tumors

samples.sample_role: Treatment-naive primary high-grade serous pelvic carcinoma

expression.label: GEO featureCounts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned GENCODE v18 GRCh37 gene_name annotation used by the source quantification command
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols assigned to more than one GENCODE v18 Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes CPM from all 57,445 source rows in each selected tumor and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values support within-cohort relative analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-defined progression-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source study baseline; the exact day-zero definition is not specified by GEO
endpoints.event_definition: Recurrence according to the released GEO field
